scripts.build: npm run build -w @dreamwalk/contracts && npm run build -w @dreamwalk/game-core && npm run build -w @dreamwalk/api && npm run build -w @dreamwalk/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @dreamwalk/contracts && npm run build -w @dreamwalk/game-core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages scripts tests docs infra *.json *.mjs *.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages scripts tests docs infra *.json *.mjs *.md
scripts.test:unit: npm test && node --import tsx --test tests/platform-config.test.mjs tests/platform-locales.test.mjs tests/postgres-stop.test.mjs
scripts.test:mail: npm run build -w @dreamwalk/contracts && npm run build -w @dreamwalk/game-core && npm run build -w @dreamwalk/api && node --test tests/mail-integration.test.mjs
scripts.test:game: npm run build -w @dreamwalk/contracts && npm run test -w @dreamwalk/game-core && node --import tsx --test tests/game/ui.test.mjs tests/game/autosave.test.mjs tests/game/privacy-living.test.mjs tests/game/context-budget.test.mjs tests/game/assets-ui.test.mjs tests/game/image-generation-ui.test.mjs tests/game/home-ui.test.mjs tests/game/hero-ui.test.mjs tests/game/scene-ui.test.mjs tests/game/narrative-ui.test.mjs tests/game/media-grounding.test.mjs tests/game/encounter-retry-ui.test.mjs tests/game/story-return.test.mjs tests/live-story-guard.test.mjs tests/live-story-quality-report.test.mjs
